1AChord A Cappella

1AChord A Cappella

1AChord is committed to the values and standards upheld by the BYUSA A Cappella Club. 1AChord pursues high-level musicality, uplifting camaraderie, and performances which align with the aims of BYU. Club members meet together regularly in preparation for performances across campus. As club members meet together, they strive to: Uphold an ongoing legacy of technical quality and exemplary unitySupport each other as a dedicated, 9-13 person performing groupProvide the BYU community with impressive, wholesome entertainmentDevelop, both individually and with other singers:Greater musical skill and performing know-howImproved teamwork and cooperative abilityConfidence, trust, and other valuable leadership traitsRepresent positively the university, BYUSA, and the a cappella industry to fansAssist in accomplishing the mission of the university and BYUSAPromote involvement in BYUSA and university programs
